entries.description: Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec for the Guild public API: accounts, agents, sessions, skills, and workspaces. Authenticated with an account API key (HTTP Basic). See https://docs.guild.ai/api-reference/introduction for scopes and conventions.
representativeQueries: How do I start a chat with a Guild agent through the API?
